New to the rings? How to play

Make a move. Select a ring or turning side and use its arrows. You can also drag along a ring, or use the notation buttons.

Look around. Drag the 3D puzzle to rotate your view. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Moving the camera never changes the puzzle.

Learn as you go. Choose Show guide inside any game for its step-by-step solution. Randomize creates a fresh legal scramble; Auto solve opens the Constrained Solver and works from the current arrangement, pausing between stages and highlighting solved nodes that later stages protect. It does not need recorded moves or promise the shortest solution; difficult states may reach the computation limit.
